forest_local.name: forest_local
forest_local.description: Fraction of a 200 m disc around the edge that's forest.

forest_wide.name: forest_wide
forest_wide.description: Fraction of a 2 km disc around the edge that's forest.

local_relief.name: local_relief
local_relief.description: Std-dev of elevation in 500 m window (meters of terrain variation — high in gorges and on mountainsides).

regional_relief.name: regional_relief
regional_relief.description: Std-dev of elevation in 10 km window — regional mountainous-ness, even where local terrain is flat.

distance_to_drama.name: distance_to_drama
distance_to_drama.description: Meters to nearest cell with local_relief ≥ 80 m. Small = visible mountains nearby. ~0 inside dramatic terrain.

view_dominance.name: view_dominance
view_dominance.description: DEM elevation minus 2 km Gaussian blur — meters above local mean.
